option_relations.rationale: Pyomyositis is a specific type of bacterial myositis.
Deep neck space infection is a broader category of infection in the neck, but the imaging specifically points to an intramuscular abscess, not necessarily a deep neck space infection in general.
Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum is a specific description of pyomyositis, which is the provided leaf.
Cervical intramuscular abscess (levator scapulae) due to F. necrophorum is a specific description of pyomyositis, which is the provided leaf. An intramuscular abscess is a form of pyomyositis.
